# NewLang Curated LLVM SDK 23.1.3

This is an unofficial, selected-file redistribution
of the LLVM Project's official Linux X64 SDK.

## Upstream identity

Release: llvmorg-23.1.3
Source commit:
0d261d1ca552c95a8f007e061c787ac7132fbcbc

LLVM-23.1.3-Linux-X64.tar.zst

Original release signing fingerprint:

## Selected components

- clang-23 and clang-format
- llvm-config
- LLVM C API headers and configuration headers
- LLVM Core and Analysis static-link dependencies
- Clang resource files and compiler-rt runtimes
- Upstream LLVM, Clang and compiler-rt license texts

Versioned tool-name symlinks were added for NewLang.

The original complete LLVM SDK is not included.
Host operating-system libraries are not bundled.

## Scope

Target: Linux x86_64

Locally tested on WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04 using:
- Strict C17 compilation
- NewLang's original LLVM C API smoke test
- Static LLVM Core + Analysis linkage
- Clang ASan and UBSan basic runtime smoke tests

This does not certify all LLVM functionality,
other hosts, or complete binary licence compliance.
